description.text: IntroductionThe program of Business Administration aims at nurturing advanced talents with hardworking, adaptable, creative, competitive and communicative abilities as well as profound knowledge of management, economics, law, corporate strategy planning, corporate imagine design, manufacturing operation, logistics planning and supply chain management, who will be able to engage in planning and management in enterprises, state-owned organizations and governments, and will be able to conduct teaching as well as research activities and meet the development of socialist market economy.Directions of CultivationCompound advanced special personnel who can take part in the application, development, and management of E-Commerce in various enterprises, Service Organization of Network, government and other agencies.Note: Bachelors' Degree for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program.Teaching ObjectivesTo help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations.Main CoursesPrinciples of Management,micro-economics,macro-economics,Management Information System,Statistics, Marketing,Economic Law, Human Resource Management,Enterprise Strategic Management, Finance ManagementInternshipHuman resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise.Degree AwardedBachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA) .Future CareerGraduates can engage in the field of human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.A recent, bareheaded, ID photo taken within the last six months2. High school graduation certificate or pre-graduation certificateIf the applicant is a current student, they must submit a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school, stating that the applicant will obtain the graduation certificate before August 25, 2025.3. A complete transcript of the high school stage4. Proof of language proficiency5. Those who have entered the Chinese mainland before must provide a scanned copy of their visa or residence permit page6. Personal information page of the passportApplicants must submit a clear scanned copy of the first page of their ordinary passport valid later than March 1, 2026. If the validity period of your current passport does not meet the requirements, please apply for a new one in a timely manner. For applicants who are unable to obtain a passport before submitting the application due to objective reasons, with the permission of the school, they may submit valid documents or supporting documents containing their name, gender, nationality, date of birth and other information.7. "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners" (Click to download template)The form must be filled out by a doctor in either Chinese or English. Applicants should undergo examinations strictly in accordance with the items required in the "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners". If there are any missing items, no personal photo attached, no cross-stamp on the photo, or no signature and seal of the doctor and the hospital, all such situations will be regarded as invalid. This inspection record is valid for six months.8. "Certificate of No Criminal Record" (Click to download template)Applicants must submit a valid certificate of no criminal record issued by the local public security authority, which is usually issued within six months prior to the date of application submission. If the applicant is truly unable to provide it, they should sign and upload the "Commitment Letter of No Criminal Record".9. Economic guarantee certificate (Click to download the template)The economic guarantor must be a natural person with full civil capacity, at least 18 years old and a stable source of income. The economic guarantor must truthfully fill out the "Economic Guarantee Certificate" and provide a scanned copy of the first page of the economic guarantor's passport or the original ID card.10. Other documents that can prove learning ability and comprehensive quality, such as award certificates, published papers, etc

requirements.text: 1.Be in good health condition; 2.Have senior high school diploma and good academic record; 3.Have basic English language ability; 4.Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits.
